Moss’Ab Mirande-Ney

📌

Hey Product Hunt !  
  
I'm Moss'Ab, co-founder of Murmell. [...] Earlier this month, Anthropic shared that it had moved its monorepo off Git after its agents took it from about 2,500 merged changes a day to more than 30,000. Their system, Scion, is internal. On Hacker News, the top complaint was simple: nobody outside Anthropic can use it.

We had hit the same wall at a much smaller scale. Murmell is currently two people and a lot of coding agents from different providers on one monorepo, and the agents had stopped being the slow part. Every change waited for a pull request and a CI run, rebased on a main that had moved, and two agents on the same file ended in a conflict someone had to settle by hand.

So we built AVP (Agent Versionning Protocol), and it's open source. [...] An agent opens a task, writes, and lands it. Every landing is proven on the exact head of main in seconds; if the line moved, the task is replayed on it and proven again. Every landing is still an ordinary Git commit, so GitHub and your deploys don't change.

On our repo, CI runs for pull requests went from 104 a day to 4. In our benchmark, with 6 to 8 Claude Code agents on one repo, main went red under Git and Jujutsu and tasks silently went missing.

With AVP, main stayed green and nothing was lost, in every run so far.

Method and numbers: avp.murmell.com

One binary: `avp up` in any Git checkout connects Claude Code and Codex.  
  
The Git side is there to make the transition easy for teams on Git today.

Title: Mahou - Immersive Art Exhibits (AVP): Fully immersive, magical art exhibitions on Apple Vision Pro | Product Hunt
Mahou - Immersive Art Exhibits (AVP). # Mahou - Immersive Art Exhibits (AVP). ## Fully immersive, magical art exhibitions on Apple Vision Pro. ## Fully immersive, magical art exhibitions on Apple Vision Pro. Mahou (maa-ho) is a platform for experiencing fully immersive original, immersive art exhibitions (~ Teamlabs, Van Gogh 360 etc). You get to feel as if they are part of the canvas themselves through immersion with art that feels alive. There has been an explosive growth in adoption of immersive art experiences. ~3 out of 4 Americans have now engaged with an immersive art experience.’ We drew inspiration from visiting exhibitions like Teamlabs (Tokyo & Osaka), Arte M (Hong Kong) and wanted to bring the same sense of awe, wonder and calm that it brought to us during these visits to people without having to step out. Furthermore, being a digital experience allows us to experiment with variety of spaces and be bolder in our choice of artists. With enough adoption, we can imagine Mahou to be the most visited digital, immersive art experience with an ongoing roster of exhibitions and artists. It took us months of work both on the UX and content and we feel we finally have a version now that's ready for you all to explore. Experience our flagship exhibition titled "Absolute Classics" featuring works from the likes of Monet, DaVinci, Anna Palm De Rosa, Hokusai and many more. We continue to iterate, improve and are committed to the platform. Hope you enjoy the spectacle we have created with Mahou. We have got some lovely coverage here as well - https://indianexpress.com/articl... congrats on the launch, the concept of mahou sounds fascinating. as immersive art becomes more accessible, how do you plan to keep the experiences fresh and engaging for repeat visitors? also, are there any particular challenges you faced in integrating with apple vision pro?

Ziwei Yao

What defines the validation an agent has to pass before landing? In particular, can a task edit the tests or configuration used to validate its own change, or is there a separate set of checks it can’t weaken? Proving a change on the current head sounds useful, but I’d want to distinguish “passes the configured checks” from “preserves the intended behavior.” I haven’t tried AVP yet; I’m curious how you handle that boundary.
